_doc: Kill-count floors per (suite::module). Tier is assigned by measured suite runtime -- see tools/mutation_ratchet.py. min_kill/module_hash/measured_at are written by --baseline and must never be hand-edited: a floor typed from memory measures memory.

tools/test_egcc_residue.py::modules/rule._why_weekly: each rule_compiler pair costs about 22s (test_egcc_residue.py runs 3.2s x 7 runs). Both on push measured 95.7s for the tier; schema.py is the core surface and stays, parser.py moves here.

tools/test_duplicate_to_advantage.py::mo._why_weekly: the suite runs 35.2s, so a 4-mutant sweep costs about 3 minutes -- roughly ten times the whole push tier. Move to "push" if that cost is acceptable.
